verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents revenue or signup attribution to specific emails or automation flows. The closest items are KPI dashboards and 'advanced data insights,' which are generic analytics and do not show conversion or revenue attribution. Email attribution is a fair axis for an email marketing platform, so the lack of evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks
